channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Panera Bread: Free Half Sandwich or Salad with $5+ Order
item.guid: Panera Bread-Free Half Sandwich or Salad with $5+ Ord-2026-08-14
item.description: Enter code FREEHALFENTREE at checkout online or in the Panera app to get a free half sandwich or half salad (a $6-9 item) with any order of $5 or more - sign in with a free MyPanera account to apply the code. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera Bread: $5.99 Strawberry Poppyseed Salad with Code SUMMER
item.guid: Panera Bread-$5.99 Strawberry Poppyseed Salad with Co-2026-08-14
item.description: Code SUMMER drops the full-size Strawberry Poppyseed Salad with grilled chicken - or the Chicken Bacon Rancher sandwich - to $5.99 on online and app orders, roughly half off the regular $12-13 price. (Limited time)

item.title: Wingstop: $24.99 Flavor Lineup: 10 Tenders Bundle for 3-4
item.description: The Flavor Lineup tenders bundle packs 10 crispy tenders in up to four flavors like Lemon Pepper and Hickory Smoked BBQ plus a large fry and a large ranch - order online or in the app, feeds three to four people. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili's-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-14
item.description: The all-day 3 For Me bundle includes a bottomless drink, chips and salsa or a house salad, and a full entree like the Big Crispy Chicken Sandwich starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chili's: Shark Attack Margarita for $6
item.description: August's margarita of the month is $6 all day at participating locations - a Lunazul Blanco tequila marg with a candy shark on top, no code needed. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Shake Shack: $1 Sodas and $3 Crinkle Cut Fries In-App
item.guid: Shake Shack-$1 Sodas and $3 Crinkle Cut Fries In-App-2026-08-14
item.description: Order through the Shake Shack app or shakeshack.com and any size soda is $1 and crinkle cut fries are $3 at participating locations - no code needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: $3.99 Deli Faves 6-Inch Subs
item.description: Subway's first standing value menu prices 6-inch Deli Faves subs at $3.99 and lists 15 entrees under $5 - no coupon, code, or app required at participating U.S. locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Starbucks: Free Refills on Brewed Coffee and Tea In-Cafe
item.guid: Starbucks-Free Refills on Brewed Coffee and Tea In-2026-08-14
item.description: Order any drink in a for-here mug or a clean personal cup and get free same-visit refills of hot or iced brewed coffee and hot or iced tea while you stay in the cafe - no account or purchase tier required. (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles & Company: $1 Side Salad with $15+ Order
item.guid: Noodles & Company-$1 Side Salad with $15+ Order-2026-08-14
item.description: Add a side salad for $1 with any online or app order of $15 or more through August 31 - an easy fresh add-on when you are already picking up dinner for the table. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)
